verdicts.evidence: A file whose NAME contains 'DRAFT-' anywhere other than at the start becomes a DRAFT. Recipe: mission init --example + adr/ADR-0115-DRAFT-mid.md with the body '**Status**: accepted'. Measured: shipped exit 0 (an ordinary accepted ADR, no marker); mutated exit 1, a Reconstruction lifecycle section with '✗ ADR-0115-DRAFT-mid.md — DRAFT — reconstructed decision not yet ratified', and the Decisions ratio goes from 5/18 to 4/18 ratified on the function battery. Nothing sees it: the seven legs replayed under the mutant stay green — every DRAFT of the net (smoke's DRAFT-legacy-boundary, --mine's DRAFT-deps-*/DRAFT-stack-node) carries the marker at position 0 where both regexes coincide, and no non-DRAFT name in the corpus contains 'DRAFT-' in the middle of the name.

The divergence exists and can be manufactured: a 540 MiB DRAFT in adr/. Shipped: the utf8 read throws INSIDE the try, the file is cleanly reported '✗ DRAFT-0500-giant.md — DRAFT — reconstructed decision not yet ratified' in a 76-line report with remediation, exit 1. Mutated: the binary read succeeds and the test's coercion throws OUTSIDE the try — check aborts in 8 lines on '✗ Cannot create a string longer than 0x1fffffe8 characters', with neither report nor remediation (exit 1 too). The violation line and the remediation are replaced by an abort, and nothing in the net carries a file of that size — it is a narrow hole (the input is extreme) but measured, not an equivalent: the equivalent standard requires an impossible neighbouring input, and this one was built in three seconds.

verdicts.evidence: Not cosmetic: the reason IS what tells the operator which marker to lift, and it travels on three surfaces. Recipe: mission init --example + ADR-0100-hyp-col0.md, check --strict with and without the mutant. Measured, same gaps and same exit 1, but: human line '✗ ADR-0100-hyp-col0.md — Status: hypothesis' → '✗ ADR-0100-hyp-col0.md — '; SARIF (--sarif, runId runward/unratified-decision) message.text 'ADR-0100-hyp-col0.md — Status: hypothesis' → 'ADR-0100-hyp-col0.md — ' — the document a CI uploads; check --json problem 'Status: hypothesis' → ''. The operator receives a condemned file without the cause, and the generic remediation at the foot of the section does not distinguish hypothesis from why-UNKNOWN. Nothing sees it: seven legs replayed green — smoke only asserts the section header and the file name, sarif-shape validates the shape of the log, never the text of the message.

verdicts.evidence: \s* → \S* between 'why' and the colon: 'why : UNKNOWN' with the French space is no longer detected. Recipe: mission init --example + ADR-0111-why-fr.md ('**Status**: accepted' + 'why : UNKNOWN'). Measured: shipped exit 1 '✗ ADR-0111-why-fr.md — why: UNKNOWN — the operator must supply it'; mutated EXIT 0 — a why that was never supplied passes the gate on the operator's typography alone, whereas the marker is generated by --mine precisely to block until the human writes the real why. (The mutant would also accept 'whyever: UNKNOWN' — the flip measured in the direction of silence is enough.) Nothing sees it: seven legs replayed green — the net's only carrier of why: UNKNOWN (smoke's DRAFT-legacy-boundary) is DRAFT-named and caught by the filename branch before this regex.
